headline: Hot Cocks Bust a 166-Point Nut and Stroud Boys Coach From the Bench
subhead: Week 7 was a shootout up top, a coma in Olave Garden, and a masterclass in lineup malpractice down in Stroud's basement.
matchOfTheWeek: Hot Cocks 166.68, Put an AR to My Head 155.96 — over 322 combined points and the loser still gets clowned. BigD rode Baker Mayfield's 29 and Joe Mixon's 26.4 like he was double-parked, while KyleDech got 26.7 from Saquon AND 25.2 from Sun God and STILL couldn't close. Imagine dropping 156 and going home empty-handed — that's a Tuesday morning hangover with no Gatorade in the fridge.
powerRankingsShakeup: T swift's Baddies and OnlyFants are flexing like they own the deed to the league, while 226 Alpha just got dragged behind a pickup truck and The Olave Garden put up a 78 that wouldn't win a JV girls' game.
mainRecap:
Let's start with the crime scene in Stroud Boys' lineup. Bjewett scored 100.58 and BEAT MassiveCocks, which is the only reason he's not getting a wellness check, because he left FIFTY-SIX POINTS on his bench. Jonnu Smith dropped 26.1 in street clothes. Javonte Williams ALSO dropped 26.1 in street clothes. The optimal lineup was 157.18. You had two different 26-point bombs rotting on the pine and still won — congrats, you're the guy who wins blackjack while folding a 20.

OnlyFants meanwhile took 226 Alpha to the woodshed 147-111, and Szara's pain was double-stuffed: David Njoku went nuclear for 28.6 in a LOSS, and Russell Wilson put up 24.86 points sitting on the bench like he was waiting for a bus. That's a 24-point QB you didn't start in SUPERFLEX. Read that sentence again and go touch grass.

T swift's Baddies cooked LargestofRocks behind Lamar's 34.44 and Gibbs' 32 — a 66-point 1-2 punch that's frankly unfair. LargestofRocks's consolation prize? Rachaad White posting 29.1 on the bench. Tnicolle also benched Tank Bigsby for 23.8, because winning by 16 wasn't disrespectful enough.

The Good Ladds squeaked past Bo Nix Celli by 8 in the closest game of the week, and Nickcelli ran the most efficient lineup in the league at 98.7% — the football equivalent of getting an A+ on the test and still failing the class. Brock Bowers went for 24.3 and it didn't matter.

Jets' Juniors beat The Olave Garden in a game that should be illegal to broadcast — 88 to 78, a combined 166 that Hot Cocks scored by himself. Patrickreegs, my man, 78 points is a halftime score. And shoutout to MassiveCocks for getting outscored by Stroud's BENCH alone. That's a special kind of awful.
